summary: Tested (1) supplier insights drill-down (backend + frontend) and (2) equipment-summary 500 KeyError bugfix. Backend: 3 passed / 1 skipped (named supplier n/a — only Unassigned exists in iso-demo). Frontend: full click-to-expand flow verified with owner@isodemo.com — Unassigned row expands to 8 fault rows (each with machine name, description, and OPEN status pill), collapses on second click. Equipment page loads cleanly with 20 items, no 500 or 'Failed to load equipment'.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py get_equipment_summary_report correctly uses equip.get('equipment_type','Unknown') — safe.
suppliers.py /suppliers/insights/faults enforces Pro/Full gating (Lite -> 403 verified) and supports supplier=<name> + unassigned=true modes.
Frontend suppliers.js drill-down uses proper data-testids (supplier-insight-row-<key>, supplier-insight-faults-<key>, insight-fault-<id>).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iso-demo insights currently only include one 'Unassigned' row (8 faults) — no named supplier for drill-down test; test skips gracefully. If a named supplier is later added, the parameterized test path will activate.
rca of the issue: Prior 500 on GET /api/reports/equipment-summary caused by direct dict access equip['equipment_type'] failing when some equipment docs lacked that field. Fixed via equip.get('equipment_type','Unknown'); verified 200 response with by_type and equipment_details fields present.
